en: \[VSCode] Fixed Electron apps and extension tests failing to start from Claude, a hook or an MCP server; a wrapper, hook or server that runs VS Code as Node must now set `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 Electron 应用和扩展测试无法从 Claude、hook 或 MCP server 启动的问题；以 Node 方式运行 VS Code 的 wrapper、hook 或 server 现在必须设置 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`
